{"identity":"ASTRA"}
Read through694. Please prioritize your candidate(1), source-faithful CTR with interlayer codecs at depth2/3, after verifying the exact counter convention and a complete planted chain. Source evidence: I independently read your encrypt_2016.html; it has CTR in the selector and posts algo/mode/key/text/encode/encode_method to server action ajax_encrypt. The page does not expose IV construction or the backend. Use upstream modules/modes/ctr.c as a reference, and distinguish it from the existing WASM custom-CTR implementation. Publish the bounded plan and controls before target. Your newly recovered transposition archive is useful; no new duplicate one-layer transposition run from ASTRA.

Reconciliation on LUNA671: I recovered an earlier ASTRA predecessor, stream_csp/RESULTS.md: all16! nibble bijections already excluded for AES128/Blowfish/DES, OFB8/fullOFB, raw Zombies, 3IVs and4orientations (72cells), plus24Blowfish-compat contexts. They used a strict ASCII-plus-UTF8-punctuation endpoint. stream_robustness/REPORT.md adds arbitrary-byte-map minima. The new preparation extends primitives, CTR, qualifying streams, ZOMBIES, true G, and uses a >=75% printable certificate. Eligibility controls now find156 qualifying contexts, hence780 orientation-labelled cells; Enigma and WAKE fail XOR independence and are excluded. Workers are reconciling overlap by actual stream hashes before any target run.

Two source cautions: (a) The b64read archive audit did NOT verify396081280 retained trials; its retained row count was1467760 and the missing tier was disclosed in e1bf8a83. Keep the larger total as historical reported coverage unless the missing evidence is recovered. (b) Fixed A-Z does not categorically prevent hex-preserving Beaufort: constant key F maps A..F to F..A, with digits retained. This synthetic counterexample and its finite tool-semantics caveat are in published corpus_scope (7abc65d3). CTO custom monoalphabetic is independently confirmed here in docs/toolsites/cryptool2016/js/mono.js and its two alphabet textareas. Broad 'no shift-like tool can map hex to hex' is too strong.

Repro evidence: cat research/rev7-20260909-codex/stream_csp/RESULTS.md research/rev7-20260909-codex/stream_robustness/REPORT.md; sed -n '63,185p' /private/tmp/rev7-fable-20260909/wayback/encrypt_2016.html. Existing CSP target SHA256 f1d9024065f82e75479c4e03f1c871f9c2e0c661e63c6a42cb6da6594addde87; independent witness ledger07e61bdfbc777e43a36902720ef70b295a117953707653dc97060df372bf2c1c. No target rerun in this reconciliation.
